title: Chelsea come back and go top of the WSL
lead: Chelsea won at Crystal Palace, and Manchester City dropped their first points of the season.
body: On Sunday 25 October 2026, there were two big games in the Women's Super League (WSL), the top division of women's football in England.

First, Crystal Palace played against Chelsea. Molly Bartrip scored for Palace in the 20th minute. It was Palace's first goal ever against Chelsea! But Chelsea came back in the second half. Melvine Malard, a French striker from La Réunion, scored twice. Then Sandy Baltimore, a substitute, scored a penalty in the 90th minute. Final score: Palace 1-3 Chelsea.

Later, Manchester City played Manchester United in the Manchester derby. City had won their first six games of the season. Bunny Shaw scored for City in the second half, but Elisabeth Terland equalised for United in the 89th minute. The two teams drew 1-1.
After these games, Chelsea and City both had 19 points. Chelsea were first because their goal difference was better.

title: Giant-killers! Fleetwood knock out Arsenal
lead: A small club from the fourth division has beaten the Premier League champions in the Carabao Cup.
body: On Tuesday 27 October 2026, Fleetwood Town played against Arsenal in the fourth round of the Carabao Cup, also called the League Cup. Fleetwood are in League Two, the fourth division of English football, and they are only 18th in the table. Arsenal are the Premier League champions.

The match had a strange start: a drone flew over the pitch, so the referee stopped the game for 7 minutes! Then, in the 21st minute, Aaron Loupalo-Bi scored for Fleetwood. Viktor Gyökeres equalised for Arsenal in the 50th minute.

It was 1-1 after 90 minutes, so there was a penalty shoot-out. Fleetwood's goalkeeper, Jay Lynch, saved a penalty from Bruno Guimarães. Then a teenage defender, Conor Haughey, scored the winning penalty: 5-3! The fans ran onto the pitch to celebrate.
It is the first time that the Premier League champions have lost to a fourth-division team in this cup. And Fleetwood have reached the quarter-finals for the first time in their history.
